segments.speaker: THEM
segments.text: Thanks for making time. I'm a recruiter here at Acme.

segments.speaker: YOU
segments.text: Happy to be here. I've been a backend engineer for six years, most recently at Globex where I owned the billing platform.

segments.speaker: THEM
segments.text: Great. Let me walk you through what's next. There are three more rounds after this one: a coding screen next week, then a system design round, and finally a panel with the VP of Engineering, Dana Liu.

segments.speaker: THEM
segments.text: The coding screen is 60 minutes in CoderPad, Python or Go.

segments.speaker: YOU
segments.text: Got it. When would the coding screen be scheduled?

segments.speaker: THEM
segments.text: I'll send times for Tuesday or Wednesday. We want to close the loop by end of month, and I'll get back to you with feedback within two business days of each round.

segments.speaker: THEM
segments.text: One thing I need from you — send me your GitHub link by Friday, the hiring manager wants to look at it before the coding screen.

segments.speaker: YOU
segments.text: Will do. What's the comp band for the role?
